proposals.title: Proposal Five - Elect Each Director Annually
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to reorganize into one class with each director elected annually for a one-year term.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reduction of director terms to one year.

proposals.title: Proposal Six - Stockholder Proposal Regarding Additional Reporting on Diversity and Inclusion Efforts
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report assessing diversity and inclusion efforts, including board process, hiring/retention metrics, and full EEO-1 disclosure.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding additional reporting on diversity and inclusion efforts.

proposals.title: Proposal Seven - Stockholder Proposal Regarding Reporting on Employee Arbitration
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on the impact of mandatory employee arbitration on harassment, discrimination and employees' ability to seek redress.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding reporting on employee arbitration.

proposals.title: Proposal Eight - Stockholder Proposal Regarding Assigning Responsibility for Strategic Oversight of Human Capital Management to an Independent Board-Level Committee
proposals.proponent: Comptroller of the City of New York
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to assign strategic oversight of human capital management, including workforce equity and inclusion, to an independent board-level committee.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding assigning responsibility for strategic oversight of human capital management to an independent board-level committee.

proposals.title: Proposal Nine - Stockholder Proposal Regarding Additional Reporting on Human Rights
proposals.proponent: Sisters of the Good Shepherd New York Province
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report assessing Tesla's human rights fulfillment and responsible sourcing practices across its value chain.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding additional reporting on human rights.
